ledger: colored balls in bowl | 8 balls in bowl plus 1 red ball held in child's hands at 00:01 (3 red, 3 yellow, 3 green total) | 8 balls swirling and morphing in bowl | held red ball vanishes at 00:02; remaining balls morph and jitter unnaturally while stirred from 00:06 to 00:09
child's hands | intact hands holding a red ball | right hand fingers blurred and deforming into spinning balls | unnatural finger distortion during stirring at 00:06-00:09

findings.description: At 00:01, the child is holding a red ball between both hands above the bowl while two other red balls sit inside the bowl. Between 00:01 and 00:02, as he lowers his hands back into the bowl, the red ball in his hands vanishes into thin air, leaving only two red balls in the bowl by 00:03.

findings.entity: colored balls and child's right hand
findings.description: From 00:06 to 00:09, as the child stirs the contents of the bowl, the balls move with unnatural jittery physics, deform into oblong shapes, and shift colors (such as a green and red ball merging/morphing on the right side at 00:08), while the child's right fingers smear and blend into the balls.
